name: Lagoon 450
description: Four double cabins and four bathrooms, built in 2018 and refitted in 2024. The afternoons happen outside: a hammock, an inflatable dock to step off into the water, a double kayak to go and see what's in the next cove. Dinner comes off the grill on deck. Starlink is on board, if anyone needs to stay reachable.
